name: Chillwind E'ko
label: Quest
description: Chillwind E'ko: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: In Winterspring, you will fight great flying creatures called da Chillwind. These beasts possess da power ta wield frost magics. If you wish ta gain resistance ta frost, bring me da E'ko you find from da Chillwind.
Rememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Mau'ari can derive da juju for friend... Use da Cache of Mau'ari to cast dis upon yourself or your allies.
